description: DISCARD twin of `osf-registration-completed`: an OSF registration whose template line is present and whose template is neither a post-completion form nor an Open-Ended Registration carrying the replication stem. What is left is the preregistration vocabulary — `OSF Preregistration`, `AsPredicted`, `OSF-Standard Pre-Data Collection`, `Replication Recipe (Brandt et al., 2013): Pre-Registration`, `Registered Report Protocol Preregistration`, `EGAP` — every one of them a form filed BEFORE data collection, describing a study that has not happened. The record announces an intention; it reports no outcome, and there is nothing for Stage 3 to code. The discard is needed rather than merely absent because these records are not silent: a Replication Recipe pre-registration's responses are full of `we will directly replicate Smith (2009)`, so under a whitelist they are admitted by `replication-claim-text` (730) and would buy two voters to be told what the template already said. That is why the precedence is 935, above the whole admission band, and it is the only reason the number is high. It sits BELOW `osf-registration-completed` (936) on purpose: the two match blocks are hand-synced copies — the format gives a spec no way to reference another — so if they ever drift the row is kept and screened rather than deleted, the cheaper of the two errors, and `tests/test_osf_registrations.py` asserts the partition. It sits below the definitional discards (940-960): those say the record is not a paper at all, this one says the record is a registration whose own template says no study has been completed. Fires on nothing until a backfill has run — the first line it matches exists only in overlay text this project wrote, and the run that writes it is the same run that produces the evidence to promote this rule out of shadow. SHADOW, and the promotion was ATTEMPTED AND REFUSED on 2026-08-04 — `analysis/osf_registrations/REPORT.md` is the run. The enumeration the shadow existed for now exists: all 3,016 no-abstract rows were fetched, 1,674 are registrations, thirteen templates appeared, and every template outside the keep arms is a pre-data-collection form. The recall gate passes EXACTLY rather than by sample: 0 of the 1,308 discards is a known FLoRA paper, and all four FLoRA registrations that have text are Post-Completion and admitted. What stopped the promotion is the read. Six Sonnet reviewers over 300 of the 1,308 discards found one record that reports a completed replication — `10.17605/osf.io/pr8a4`, an EGAP registration whose text says "In Table 1 I replicate models 1-3 from Kerner... and present these results in Models 4-6 in Table 2" — which is a point estimate of ~4.4 papers lost to this one rule, and CONVENTIONS.md is explicit that any real study in the sample stops the promotion. Note what does NOT rescue that row: its own structured timing field claims "Registration prior to researcher access to outcome data", contradicting its content, so no OSF timing field can be trusted to catch the class. Three candidate narrowings are in the report, none measured; the sharpest is standing down on a past-tense results-reporting construction in the record's own text. The recall gate passing is not a substitute for the read — `flora.csv` is what FLoRA has already found, and the Kerner replication is exactly the kind of record that is not in it yet. D3 (is a planned-but-not-completed replication a FLoRA record?) is settled for THIS registrant by the maintainer ruling of 2026-08-04 and nowhere else — the `aim|set out to replicate` arm elsewhere in the bundle is untouched by it. PROMOTED 2026-08-05 as `discard`, on a maintainer re-adjudication of the one blocking case: the refusal above blocked DELETION — one real completed replication (pr8a4) in a 300-row read is a real study lost, and CONVENTIONS.md stops the promotion. Routing the same match to `needs_human` deletes nothing: the ~1,300 rows leave the screen pile (no voter spend, no Stage 3) and sit in a pile a human can read in an afternoon, which is exactly where a Kerner-type record is found rather than lost. Narrowing 1 (a results-reporting stand-down regex) remains open as the path to a true discard, and needs its own measured sample before anyone attempts it. The re-adjudication, 2026-08-05: pr8a4's own q15 says it is a MOCK write-up solicited for the ISQ blog, its attachment is a pre-analysis plan (`_PAP.docx`), and q17's past-tense results text is quoted mock prose — the EGAP genre of writing a PAP as a dummy results section. Read whole, the record is prospective, q8's 'prior to outcome data' agrees with it, and the 2026-08-04 'real loss' was an over-call: the clean sample of 300 contains zero completed replications, so the recall gate passes and CONVENTIONS' stop no longer binds.

measured.rationale: Promotion to a live discard. Match block unchanged from the refused 2026-08-04 promotion, so its enumeration and recall gate still describe this population. The single blocking case (pr8a4) was re-read whole by the maintainer on 2026-08-05 and ruled prospective — a mock write-up on a pre-analysis plan, not a completed replication — bringing the sample's real-study count to zero. Discard is a routing pile, not a deletion: the works stay in the pool and a future bundle can route them again.

measured.sample: 300 rows drawn uniformly at random (random_state=17) from the 1,308 rows this rule discards over the full no-abstract 10.17605 population, 2026-08-04. Read by six claude-sonnet-5 agents over the registration's own recovered text, truncated at 3,000 characters, asked only whether the record reports results of a replication already run, told to judge from the text alone and to err toward keeping. Labels come from the record, nothing downstream of this rule. Artifacts: analysis/osf_registrations/{REPORT.md, review_sample.csv, review_verdicts.csv}.
measured.rationale: 259 plan / 36 unclear / 5 flagged; all five read by hand. One is a real loss: 10.17605/osf.io/pr8a4, a completed replication of Kerner's FDI models written up in past tense on the EGAP template. Two were over-calls stating a PRIOR study's outcome (a class project; the van 't Veer template's prior-work field), one an inference from a journal-acceptance sentence, and one a completed botany study that is not a replication at all and so costs nothing. One real study in 300 of 1,308 is a point estimate of V/n = 4.4 papers lost against a database holding ~1,500, so CONVENTIONS.md's rule applies: do not promote, narrow the rule, start again. The 36 unclear rows push the same way — most have no content beyond `looked: No`, and a rule that deletes what nobody can read is the case the evidence gate exists for.

measured.sample: The whole no-abstract population on registrant 10.17605 — 25,819 pool rows on the registrant, 3,016 without an abstract, counted on disk by analysis/osf_registrations/build_worklist.py. Templates fetched for all of them 2026-08-04; 1,674 resolved to registrations, 1,342 are OSF projects/components the registrations endpoint 404s on. Each row put through this spec and its twin by eval_spec_rows().
measured.rationale: An exact count over a named population, not a reading of what the rule discards — which is why the level is heuristic even though nothing here is estimated. It settles two things and neither is precision. (1) The negation holds across the enumerated vocabulary: thirteen templates, every one outside the keep arms a pre-data-collection form. (2) The recall gate passes exactly: 0 known FLoRA papers among the 1,308 discards, over the population rather than a sample — and 0 under every version of the gold standard measured so far, which is the part worth keeping. The denominator moved three times: 8 known FLoRA rows by a DOI-only match, 16 once OSF records FLoRA names by URL are counted (`_osf_doi_keys()` in shared/flora_skip.py), and 64 against the flora.csv regenerated 2026-08-05, the first release carrying the OSF registration DOIs added to the COS source sheet that day. The numerator stayed at zero throughout. It also corrects a number the 60-row sample produced — the population holds far more than the 10 known FLoRA papers estimated — and settles that no post-data-collection template exists here at all, so dropping that keep arm cost nothing.
